🌱 IT Support Specialist – Greenfield Project 
 We are proud to announce the launch of Diehl Aviation's new manufacturing facility in Craiova, developed in partnership with ManpowerGroup Romania.
 This collaboration combines Diehl Aviation's world-class engineering standards with ManpowerGroup's talent-building expertise, creating a benchmark for sustainable and high-performance operations in the aerospace industry.
 🧭 About the Role: 
 As an IT Support Specialist , you will play an important role in supporting the daily IT operations of our production site in Romania.
 Working closely with the IT Site Coordinator and the central Shared Service Center (Diehl Informatics), you will provide first-level user support, ensure that workplace equipment is functioning efficiently, and contribute to the smooth operation of local IT services during the site's setup and growth phase.
 🔹 Key Responsibilities: 
Serve as the first point of contact for users experiencing standard IT issues and service requests
Support employees with workplace hardware, printers, telephones, and standard software applications
Record, track, and update incidents and service requests in the IT service management system
Escalate complex incidents and requests to the IT Coordinator or the central Shared Service Center when required
Install, configure, and replace workplace hardware, including PCs, notebooks, monitors, and peripherals
Set up and deploy new workstations according to company standards
• Assist with printer installation, troubleshooting, and basic network-related activities
Support inventory management, asset tracking, and equipment identification processes
Assist during IT rollouts, office relocations, and hardware refresh projects
Support external IT service providers during on-site activities
Maintain local IT documentation, asset records, and inventories
Follow IT security procedures and report potential security incidents or irregularities
 🔹 Essential Requirements 
Completed vocational training in Information Technology or a comparable technical qualification
Alternatively, relevant practical experience in IT support, helpdesk, or workplace services
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Windows workplace environments
Basic understanding of computer hardware, peripherals, printers, and workplace technologies
Basic understanding of networking concepts and printer support
Experience with ticketing systems is considered an advantage
Customer-service orientation and proactive approach to user support
Good communication skills and ability to work effectively within a team
Reliable, structured, and organized working style
Willingness to learn, develop technical skills, and take a hands-on approach to daily activities
English language skills, both written and spoken
 ✈️ Why Join Diehl Aviation? 
 At Diehl Aviation , we take pride in innovation, precision, and responsible engineering.
 Together with ManpowerGroup Romania , we are building a workplace that promotes excellence, collaboration, and sustainability — where every professional can contribute to shaping a safer and more efficient future in aerospace manufacturing.
 📩 If you are an IT professional who enjoys helping users, solving technical issues, and working in a dynamic production environment, we would be happy to hear from you. 
 👉 Join us in building something exceptional. 
 Apply now or contact ManpowerGroup Romania for more details.
